records.measurement: A single pass of soft enolization followed by racemic CSA protonolysis gives an approximately 1.1:1 trans:cis ketoester mixture.
Reversible keto–enol tautomerization experiments afforded trans material. No equilibrium constant was measured.
Three rounds of the CSA sequence gave 70% cumulative isolated cis material.
